cases.name: TSV
cases.source: Original user case: photographs converted to CMD by OCR and manually corrected; the user confirmed the original-version identity.
cases.adapt: The OCR-converted directory is the original input. The repository integrates a mesh-simplified version. cmd_flat and cmd organize the same inputs differently; they are not the original and simplified versions.
cases.original: D:/WORK/qx_deck/SI/tsv_stress/cmd_flat/; cmd/ contains categorized copies; ocr_clean/photo_to_cmd_manifest.csv traces photographs to CMD files.
cmd: Corresponding pp* copies: 21 files; common templates / execution graph: 4 files
cases.flow: Photographs → OCR / correction → 7 original chains × 3 stages → repository mesh-simplified version → verification workflow
cases.note: The original verify_in_vm.sh performs vendor syntax checks only: 28 expanded files plus one expanded template. The user confirmed integration of the simplified version; repository paths, verification entry point and current results remain to be checked.
cases.feature: TSV thermal stress · temperature history · material / mesh preprocessing · fixed displacement and directional constraints

cases.name: Backend / Package reliability
cases.source: Backend / Package_ThermomechanicalReliability; archived as a PowerSO-10RF / LDMOS adaptation.
cases.adapt: Geometry, materials and solution flow were adapted. The benchmark separates thermal and mechanical solution entry points.
cases.flow: Geometry / mesh.tdr → thermal_bench.cmd → temperature output → mechanics_bench.cmd
cases.verify: Standalone validation recorded; regression integration pending confirmation
cases.note: The two solution CMD files run sequentially. Geometry generation is an additional prerequisite. Four-step mechanics, 400 K, initial-temperature and parameter-error checks are variants of this case.
cases.feature: Steady-state heat transfer · conduction / convection / radiation · thermal expansion · thermal stress
cases.device: Power semiconductor package, adapted from a PowerSO-10RF / LDMOS device package.
cases.background: Uneven heating causes differential thermal expansion between package materials, producing thermomechanical stress. The temperature field is mapped into the mechanical calculation.

cases.name: Submodeling
cases.source: Adapted from part of an existing case (confirmed by user); the exact parent-case mapping remains to be checked.
cases.adapt: The workflow targets global displacement mapping onto a refined single-pillar mesh. It is an adaptation, not an independently invented case.
cases.original: Candidate source: original/submodel-candidates/PackageAssembly_Stress/*; vendor-original.cmd is also archived, but this does not establish direct derivation.
cases.flow: Global geometry / mesh → global.cmd → global displacement → unit-fine.cmd → local stress
cases.verify: Standalone validation recorded; regression integration pending confirmation
cases.note: The two solution CMD files have a data dependency. Frozen-mesh variants are global-freeze.cmd / unit-fine-freeze.cmd. Temperature is a prescribed cooling load, not a heat-conduction solution.
cases.feature: Global-to-local displacement mapping · local refinement · mechanical constraints
cases.device: Flip-chip package with a 3 × 3 copper-pillar array and a single-pillar submodel.
cases.background: Cooling from 180 °C to 25 °C. Global displacement is mapped to the refined single-pillar mesh to solve local stress.

cases.name: Quasistatic equilibrium
cases.source: Purpose-built feature case (confirmed by user), with no direct external reference case.
cases.adapt: The same model produces 16 frames with different loads. These form one case series, not 16 independent features.
cases.original: Purpose-built baseline; the archived vendor-reference-cantilever.cmd is a separately retained reference, without a confirmed derivation relationship.
cases.flow: setup.py / refine.py → shared mesh → case.cmd for each frame
cases.verify: Run records available; regression integration pending confirmation
cases.note: The 16 CMD files are parameter variants, not a sequential 01→16 result chain. An arch-quasistatic variant is also retained.

cases.name: Linear buckling
cases.source: Archived feature demonstration deck; original provenance remains to be checked.
cases.adapt: The main case is retained separately from plate-buckling and arch-linear. Three and six modes are solver-configuration variants.
cases.flow: Mesh preparation → case.cmd → eigenvalues / buckling modes / TDR
cases.verify: Standalone validation recorded; regression integration pending confirmation
cases.note: One main solution CMD. Recorded ARPACK-call validation does not establish validation of every buckling variant.
cases.feature: Linear buckling · ARPACK · eigenvalue and mode output

cases.name: Post-buckling
cases.source: Archived feature demonstration series; direct provenance remains to be checked.
cases.adapt: Supercritical is the main case; post-buckling is an earlier subcritical calibration, and arch-snap is a separate variant.
cases.verify: Archive available; regression integration pending confirmation
cases.note: The directories contain independent variants, not multiple CMD files forming one pipeline. Complete passing status has not been confirmed.

cases.name: Large deformation
cases.source: Archived feature demonstration series; direct provenance remains to be checked.
cases.adapt: Paired geometric-nonlinearity OFF / ON comparison; v2 is the entry point designated by the archive documentation.
cases.original: Original geometric-off/on versions and v2 are both retained.
cases.flow: Shared geometry / mesh → separate OFF and ON solutions → comparison
cases.note: The two CMD files are paired runs, not sequentially dependent. The user explicitly deferred large-deformation validation.

details.name: Point-force boundary conditions
details.commands: stressdata bc.location=pointend point.coord={0 0 0} bc.value={pfx=0 pfy=0 \ pfz=@p@<dyn>}

details.name: Point-displacement rate boundary conditions
details.commands: stressdata bc.location=<c> bc.value={pdx=<n> pdy=<n> pdz=<n>} point.coord={<n> <n> <n>}

details.name: Pressure boundary conditions
details.reference: p.111 Pressure Boundary Condition; p.694 stressdata

details.name: Bottom thermal boundary condition
details.commands:
pdbSet <material> AttachThermalResistor 1
pdbSet WaferThickness <n>
pdbSet Env.Temp <n>

details.name: Prescribed temperature boundary
details.reference: p.709 supply — Specifies a constant temperature supply.

details.name: Voltage supply
details.reference: p.709 supply — Specifies a constant voltage supply.

details.name: Absolute / relative thermal expansion coefficients
details.commands:
pdbSetDouble Mechanics RefThExpCoeff 0
or
pdbSetDouble Mechanics RefThExpCoeff <n>

details.name: Specific heat, thermal conductivity and density
details.commands:
pdbSet <material> MassDensity <n>
pdbSet <material> SpecificHeatCapacity <expression>
pdbSet <material> Temperature Conductivity <expression>

details.name: Viscoelasticity
details.commands:
pdbSetDouble Pass Mechanics Viscosity0 1e40
pdbSetDouble Pass Mechanics ViscosityW 0.0

details.name: Electrical conductivity
details.reference: p.17? Thermal Analysis (page number obscured by the pointer)

details.name: Newton iteration parameters
details.commands:
pdbSet Mechanics MaxIterations 20
pdbSet Mechanics Convergence.Force.Tolerance 1e-3
pdbSet Mechanics Convergence.Energy.Tolerance 1e-3

details.name: Mechanical submodeling
details.commands:
stressdata global.model=<c>
or
pdbSet Mechanics Submodel <c>

details.name: Fluid surface tension and pressure
details.reference: p.122 Effective Surface Tension and Pressure due to Fluid

details.name: Stress-history tracking
details.reference: p.126 Automated Tracing of Stress History

details.name: Time-step control
details.commands:
solve temperature=180.0<C> t.final=25.0<C> delNT=155.0 \
time=1.0<s> init=1.0<s> maxstep=1.0<s>

details.name: Principal stresses and directions
details.commands:
pdbSet Mechanics Calculate.Principal.Stress 1
pdbSet Mechanics Calculate.Principal.Direction 1

details.name: Maximum-stress tracking
details.reference: p.14? Tracking Maximum Stress (page number obscured by the pointer)

details.name: Electrothermal coupling and Joule heating

details.name: Iterative solver configuration
details.commands:
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.method sts3
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.tolrel 1e-3
pdbSetDouble Math Flow ILS.refine.residual 1e-3
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.ilut.tau 1e-14
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.scaling diagsym
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.nonsymmOrdering none
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.refine.sts 1
pdbSet Math Flow 3D ILS.leftPreconditioner 1
details.reference: p.400 Setting Parameters of the Iterative Solver ILS
